question: Does the Quezon advisory label “Lakayat” refer to the source-named Labayat River or Labayat principal basin?
purpose: Record the independently source-named Labayat river and regional principal-basin leads while keeping the advisory name relationship partial and unconfirmed.

findings.evidence: Quezon Provincial Government General Flood Advisory No. 14, issued 7 August 2026, lists “Lakayat” among watercourses likely to be affected by that forecast.
supports: Quezon grouping of this advisory label
doesNotSupport: identity with Labayat River or the Labayat basin
a specific municipality, channel, or reach
current flood status or fish occurrence

findings.evidence: DENR-BMB 2016 Atlas Annex 2b row BL 75 names “Labayat River” under Region IV-A, with locality text listing Real, Quezon and Sta. Maria, Famy, and Siniloan, Laguna; the reported outflow is Lamon Bay.
supports: source-reported locality context in Quezon and Laguna
doesNotSupport: a complete channel route or exact advisory reach

findings.evidence: DPWH Department Order No. 47, s. 2022, Annex D-2 row 101 lists “Labayat” under Region IV-A and reports 56 sq km.
supports: official Region IV-A principal-basin name and reported area
doesNotSupport: identity with Labayat River or advisory “Lakayat”
a route, channel-to-basin topology, or boundary geometry

crosswalk.resolutionLevel: partial possible spelling variant only; neither the advisory identity nor the channel-to-basin relationship is verified
crosswalk.confidence: The Quezon advisory label “Lakayat” is close in spelling to two independently listed “Labayat” features. The Atlas places Labayat River in a locality list including Real, Quezon, while DPWH lists a Labayat principal basin in Region IV-A. These sources make a name-variant check reasonable but do not confirm a typo, synonym, shared feature, or channel-basin relationship.
crosswalk.mergeDecision: Add the Atlas-named river and DPWH-named regional basin as separate research leads. Retain “Lakayat” as a partial candidate for both; do not merge the advisory label with either lead or merge the river and basin together.

reuseAndLimitations: The BMB Atlas is a historical inventory and its localities do not define channel geometry or present waterbody status.
The DPWH reported 56 sq km is a principal-basin table area, not a channel length or mapped boundary.
The advisory and source inventories spell the names differently; no source reviewed here confirms the spelling relationship.
The river and basin remain separate because route-scale evidence does not establish their topology.
The Quezon advisory is a dated forecast, not current hazard guidance.
No fish occurrence or absence, complete checklist, salinity, current water quality, access, fishing legality, or safety is inferred.
No item-specific open-data license or public-app publication approval was established for the Atlas- or DPWH-derived research metadata.
nextActions: Seek an authoritative Quezon or DPWH locality/technical-description source for the advisory spelling “Lakayat.”
Seek route-scale hydrography before joining the Labayat river and basin leads.
Review dated, station-resolved fish evidence independently for each verified waterbody.
nonClaims: No basin polygon or river centerline is inferred from the 56 sq km reported area or Atlas localities.
“Lakayat” is not declared a typo, synonym, or confirmed alias of Labayat.
The Labayat river and principal basin are not treated as the same feature.
No fish presence or absence, complete checklist, salinity, current water quality, current hazard, fishing access or legality, or safety is asserted.
